objective: Frozen computation: each of EXPLOSIVE's 15 stopped explosive starts grown round by round in a limited child; after each round the stage taken as a start is classified, and once it lies in the proved class its future is counted exactly by DEAD-CAP's branch system (no bound on places) and checked by growing further where feasible.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (4 of 5 held, R3 failed; referee pending): of EXPLOSIVE's 15 stopped explosive starts, one reaches a readable stage and closes (a 974-parent merge at round 8 leaves 781 live junctions in one block; the burst then makes about 2^781 junctions and ends; computed, unchecked by growth); 14 stay unreadable within 6 GB and 15 minutes (10 memory, 4 time; groups 12 to 446; maximal blocks still share two knots); the control reads and checks exactly; none shown to keep growing.
title: The 15 stopped explosive starts, read from their stages
